text: Ko Kanko waɗi leydi ndi wonani on mbertu ndaɗɗudi, O waɗi dow mon asamaan o mahaaɗo e ñeeñal, Kanko tigi neeminiri on jippinde toɓo ngo, O fuɗni dow leydi ndi ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe ceertuɗe, ɗe ngoni njeɗu, taa mbaɗanee Alla renndidiiɓe e nanndidiiɓe tawa oɗon nganndi alaa fof tagoowo sonaa Alla, teddungal e mawngu woodanii Mbo.
